synthesis.summary: Strong bullish conviction across all LightGBM timeframes is currently supported by an influx of large flow trades, including a $10.8M premium. However, this upward momentum is clashing with structural instability indicated by negative GEX and an explosive volatility regime.
synthesis.key_observation: Bullish ML signals are decoupled from a fragile, negative-gamma market structure.
synthesis.risk_flag: Negative GEX and explosive vol regime increase the probability of sharp, violent mean-reversion events.
